headline: Kinder Morgan (KMI) Stock Still Looks Undervalued Following Its 141% Run
summary: Kinder Morgan stock has delivered a 141.2% total return over the past 5 years, yet current checks suggest the shares sit in a middle ground where the intrinsic value estimate points to meaningful upside while market multiples look closer to fair. That tension between a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) view that indicates the stock trades at a 42.7% discount to intrinsic value and broader valuation signals that are more neutral is what investors are weighing now. headline: Record Q2 Results And Raised 2026 Guidance Might Change The Case For Investing In Kinder Morgan (KMI)
summary: Kinder Morgan, Inc. has already reported its Q2 2026 results, posting higher sales of US$4,477 million and net income of US$867 million versus the prior year, alongside year-to-date gains in revenue and earnings per share from continuing operations. The company’s record quarter, broad-based segment contributions, and decision to raise full-year 2026 guidance highlight how growing natural gas demand and a sizeable project backlog are influencing Kinder Morgan’s earnings profile.
